completeness.why: Every site takes the category selection from isMonthFillCategory/getMonthFillCategories with a named rule preset (COPY_RULES, SET_ZERO_RULES, AVERAGE_RULES) and both average sites take the sign from averageToBudget; copyPreviousMonth only keeps iterating its own budget rows, which is its own data.

interface.why: Two booleans (includeHidden, unknownVisibilityIsHidden) capture exactly the preserved inconsistencies and are exposed through three named presets; minor wart is that unknownVisibilityIsHidden is meaningless when includeHidden is true.

disguised_duplication.where: The income, hidden and sign rules each exist once in actions.ts; no site re-expresses them.
